result.reason: The affiliate, contractor, and successor concepts are largely addressed, but the operative language does not achieve the preferred termination standard: it permits revocation upon any expiration or termination under paragraph 4, rather than limiting termination of a subscription licence to uncured material breach. It also does not provide perpetual, irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. Transferability to any permitted assignee under paragraph 8(h) is broader than the required successor transfer, and the direct grant plus sublicensing formulation is redundant. The retained statement that the licence “shall be revoked,” with an inconsistent section reference, also creates ambiguity. Unrelated platform-use and commercial mechanics are otherwise preserved.
